meta.name: extract-source-sample
meta.description: Given the path to a finished content-goose ad-run folder, extract everything that defines that ad — recipe shot list, VO script, characters, voices, world, atom-skills, master mp4 — and emit a `source-sample.json` in the exact shape the `upload-ad-sample` skill writes to the Goose Ads library. Also links every character and voice to the central character library at `<repo-root>/assets/character-library/` (repo-root derived from the run-dir, not a hardcoded path), and if a character isn't in the library yet, adds it first then links. Use when the user wants to remix one of their existing ads — this skill produces the source JSON that the script-rewriting step and `remix-ad` consume.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Extract ad definition and generate source file

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会读取一个已完成广告的运行文件夹，提取其中的镜头列表、配音脚本、角色、声音、场景、所用技能和最终视频，生成一个 `source-sample.json` 文件。同时，它会将每个角色和声音链接到中央角色库，如果角色不在库中则先添加再链接。
howto.when: 当你想重新混剪（remix）自己已有的广告时触发。你需要提供广告运行文件夹的路径。

say.text: 帮我准备这个广告的 remix 数据。
say.note: Claude 会生成供后续步骤使用的 JSON。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude reads a finished ad-run folder, extracts the shot list, VO script, characters, voices, world, atom-skills, and master mp4, and emits a `source-sample.json` file. It also links every character and voice to the central character library, adding missing characters first.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to remix one of your existing ads. You need to provide the path to the ad-run folder.

say_en.note: Claude reads the folder and generates the JSON.
Claude generates the JSON for the next steps.
